_doc: Part C panel sets (CMAZE-T, words-plus-observation (BOTH) TEST, persisted w19 objects). One entry in panel_sets = one figure; one entry in arms = one column. A second pass (improved CLU config) adds its arm column(s) here and its per-item re-read beside cmazet_items.json; no code change. The 10x-read-floats diagnostic is not a matched rival (never a bar) and is not drawn. PW-1: names n-CLU / n-CLU-REL / baselines; no explanatory paragraph under the images; 'drawn_rows' / 'override_rows' name slots of cmazet_door_search.py (fixed-seed stratified draw among n-CLU door successes, by rule); fig_cmazet_deletion retired (status 'retired', PW-1 item 17).

arms.key: arm: BLIND-COLOUR (learned: colour identity removed from the request)
arms.name: blind colour

arms.key: arm: BLIND-SEQUENTIAL (learned: main effects only, no interaction terms)
arms.name: blind sequential

panel_sets.notes: One held-out TEST n-way transition per rule family: the first in the scorer's capped order at seed 0, else at the first seed that has one. Columns: s_t with the action, the engine's s_{t+1}, then each arm's generated s_{t+1} (apply_outcome of its own emission) with the engine's judge's mark. PW-1: + two rows drawn by rule (cmazet_door_search.py): one where the n-CLU is right and >= 4 of the 6 matched baselines are wrong (base n-CLU, seeds 0-2), and one n-CLU door success (key consumed, door then tint) - the base n-CLU has none at seeds 0-2, so it is drawn from the n-CLU-REL run, every column of that row from that run.

Door-then-tint (interaction family): the first seed-0 TEST n-way row per move direction present. Same columns as fig_cmazet_families. PW-1: + n-CLU door-then-tint successes, one per move direction present, drawn by rule (cmazet_door_search.py); the base n-CLU has none at seeds 0-2, so they come from the n-CLU-REL run, every column of those rows from that run.

For every arm, one seed-0 TEST n-way transition on which it is right and one on which it is wrong, each a uniform draw (numpy default_rng(21), arms in manifest order) among the qualifying rows; an arm with no qualifying row gets no row (recorded in selection).

Value deletion of colour 1 (the deleted colour recorded in the artefact), seed 0: on surviving-colour TEST n-way rows (the rows the deletion rows score), the first per rule family. Columns: the CLU before deletion, after the downdate, and fitted without the rows (the deletion pair; equal emissions on every surviving row, recorded), and the matched MLP as trained and retrained without.
panel_sets.retired: PW-1 item 17 (Head, 2026-09-25): the post-deletion panel figure leaves the paper; not built. Old files are not deleted.

panel_sets.notes: CLU-REL-A10 (the improved CLU config). For every arm, including the six '+rel' diagnostic rivals (rivals given the CLU's relational request columns; not matched baselines), one seed-0 TEST n-way transition on which it is right and one on which it is wrong, each a uniform draw (numpy default_rng(21), arms in manifest order) among the qualifying rows; an arm with no qualifying row gets no row (recorded in selection). Same rows and rule as fig_cmazet_per_arm. PW-1: the n-CLU-REL 'succeeds' row is a door-then-tint success drawn by rule (cmazet_door_search.py; the seed-0 uniform draw is still consumed so every other row is unchanged).
panel_sets.gate2: PASSED 132/132 arms float== the scored run JSONs, seeds 0-5; 144 objects hash-checked before and after load (w21_figures/cmazet_extract_rel.py; data/cmazet_items_rel.REPRO.json)
panel_sets.gate_note: per-item re-read of the persisted CLU-REL-A10 BOTH TEST objects (hash-verified; every arm's n-way score equals the scored run JSON, float ==, asserted in cmazet_extract_rel.py, seeds 0-5);
